'When this hits, the next attack action card with 2 or less base {p} you play this combat chain gains +2{p}.' + printed Go again.

GO AGAIN NOT AUTHORED: GoAgain is in printed_keywords - it fires unconditionally from the card DB keywords field, and on THIS card that is correct: the printed go again is not gated on anything (unlike a 'if X, this gets go again' rider), so no SOURCE_IS_ATTACK conditional-keyword shape applies and re-authoring it would be a defect.

TRIGGER: TRIGGERED + ON_HIT, UNGATED - the text says 'hits', not 'hits a hero', so there is deliberately no ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO gate (same reading as the shipped combustible_courier family). Deadly Duo hits during its OWN attack, so the buff lands on a LATER attack of the same chain.

PUMP: MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK reads mod/amount/filter/scope (effect_types.py:4592-4618) and queues a one-shot entry on the controller's dsl_queued_attack_mods, consumed by the first attack whose filter matches (engine.py:1175-1236). scope CHAIN is what makes 'this combat chain' hold: chain-scoped entries are dropped at chain close (engine.py:794-802) instead of surviving into a later chain of the same turn.

FILTER copied from the SHIPPED evr/ride_the_tailwind_blue.json, whose printed filter clause is word-for-word identical ('the next attack action card with 2 or less base {p} you play this combat chain') and whose review status is ok - only the payoff differs (+2{p} vs go again). ATTACK_BASE_POWER_LTE reads the base recorded when the attack was declared (combat.base_attack_power, falling back to attack_card.base_power; condition_types.py:511-542), so a pumped attack whose BASE is 2 or less still qualifies and a boosted-to-4 attack does not - exactly 'base {p}'. ATTACK_TYPE_IN reads types+subtypes, so 'Action' matches attack action cards (types=['Action']) and rejects weapon/ally attacks so they do not burn the grant.

No gaps; every clause expressible.
